_meta.description: Real GitHub pull_request webhook, action=closed (merged=true) — the SAME PR (identical pull_request.node_id) as pull_request_opened.json, later in its lifecycle. GitHub reuses the node_id byte-for-byte across deliveries, so a handler that adopts node_id verbatim as external_id would dedup this merge onto the open and SILENTLY LOSE the merge state-change (#1). external_id must encode the action. Doc-derived; ids/logins are placeholders.
_meta.source: doc:https://docs.github.com/en/webhooks/webhook-events-and-payloads#pull_request (action=closed + merged; pull_request.node_id identical to the opened delivery)

headers.X-Hub-Signature-256: sha256=<hex hmac-sha256 of the raw body>
